title: 11 Best Herbal Tinctures For Heartburn
intro: Herbal tinctures for Heartburn are liquid extracts made from plants that have been traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of heartburn and acid reflux. Additionally, other herbal tinctures such as peppermint, licorice root, and meadowsweet have also been used to treat heartburn due to their ability to relax the muscles in the digestive tract and reduce inflammation.
